Execute a program in a running VM.

```text
pomme exec [FLAGS] [NAME] -- [COMMAND ...]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted before --. |
| `COMMAND` | Executable and arguments after --. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d`, `--detach` | Create the PTY session without attaching and print its session ID. |
| `-i`, `--stdin` | Read binary standard input from the host. |
| `--pty` | Attach the command to a pseudo-terminal. |
| `--cwd CWD` | Absolute guest working directory. |
| `-e`, `--env ENV` | Guest environment entry in KEY=VALUE form. Repeatable. |
| `--user USER` | Guest user name. |
| `--uid UID` | Guest numeric user ID. |
| `--group GROUP` | Guest group name. |
| `--gid GID` | Guest numeric group ID. |
| `--guest-stdin GUEST_STDIN` | Absolute guest file used as standard input. |
| `--guest-stdout GUEST_STDOUT` | Absolute guest file used as standard output. |
| `--guest-stderr GUEST_STDERR` | Absolute guest file used as standard error. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
